caseName: Bank of California, National Ass'n v. Roberts
caseNameFull: Bank of California, National Association, v. Roberts, Treasurer of the State of California
syllabus: Decided on authority of Bank of California v. Richardson, ante, p. 476. 173 California, 398, reversed.
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OP THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA.
attorneys: Mr. E. S. Pittsburg, Mr. F. D. Madison, Mr. Alfred Sutro and Mr. Oscar Sutro for plaintiff in error. Mr. A. D. Plaw was also on the brief., Mr. U. S. Webb, Attorney General of- the State of California, and Mr. Raymond Benjamin,. Chief Deputy Attorney General, of the State of California, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

This case is controlled by the opinion in Bank of California v. Richardson, ante, p. 476. Indeed, it was submitted without briefs upon the briefs filed in that ease. For the reasons stated' in the previous case, therefore, the judgment here must be reversed and the case remanded for further proceedings not inconsistent with this opinion.

Reversed.
